evidence.notes: Database.Batchable<T> enforces the execute scope item type at compile time.

source.content: public class WrongScopeBatch implements Database.Batchable<Integer> { public Iterable<Integer> start(Database.BatchableContext context) { return new List<Integer>{1}; } public void execute(Database.BatchableContext context, List<String> scope) {} public void finish(Database.BatchableContext context) {} }
